migrationFixture.publisher: Fresh ephemeral ECDSA P-256 QA key generated by the .NET test process
migrationFixture.legacyFiles: Authenticated state.json, both inert signed releases, vision-calibration.json, and logs; original bytes checked before/after

interruptionObserver.method: Already-running dedicated filesystem polling observer cancels when the real staging-copy output is created. Migration runs on a dedicated worker.
interruptionObserver.resolvedTestIssue: The initial recursive FileSystemWatcher observer could miss files inside newly-created stage directories and was replaced; those failing attempts are not reported as product failures or passing checks.

coverage: Absolute appDirectory/data is independent of CWD; no CWD fallback created.
Stable legacy files copied, original files byte-identical, transient/unknown files not merged.
Moving entire application directory preserves signed-version validation and local rollback.
Any existing user data or initialized portable state prevents all legacy merging.
Pre-cancel, true 128MiB staged-copy cancellation, and source sharing violation leave no partial data/stage.
Destination and production legacy lock contention reject busy or respect cancellation, and release for retry.
Overlapping source/destination, symlink roots/ancestors/files/directories/data targets are rejected.
Unwritable application directory fails explicitly under Linux UID 1000; no AppData fallback.
Sparse file exceeding the 256MiB individual-file cap and blocked QA .pem placeholder reject during planning without reading contents.
limitations: Linux console execution only; Windows WPF/host startup, ACLs, reparse-point behavior and EXE execution were not run.
The Host must pass its executable directory as appDirectory; that wiring is outside this filesystem test runner.
Cancellation and reconstructed failure cases exercise cleanup boundaries, not arbitrary hardware power loss.
Storage tests use authenticated inert QA releases; they do not load assemblies or claim game accuracy/rewards.

realSignedPayloadCheck.scope: Final 0.4.2 signed feed and payload from dist; native offline bootstrap, every declared file hash, then tampered App.dll rejected.
